name: Whistle of the Vagrant
summary: A small fabled whistle the Vagrant left in the mud. Attuned: +1 to every saving throw (the Rare tier; its higher tiers wait on the level steps).
text: The whistle is warm and light, and carved with a train no bigger than a thumbnail. Attuned to it, you stand a little steadier against whatever the dark throws at you: +1 to every saving throw. The Vagrant's other gifts for it (a hush for the dead, a sense for the restless, a fog at dusk) come with the higher tiers.
